Future exhibitions and displays

The museum explores the past, present and future of design through a programme of temporary exhibitions and displays.

Join membership and get closer to design. Members go free all year and enjoy special discounts and events.

Sign up to the newsletter to stay in touch and receive our latest news.

Coming soon

2 October 2026 – 4 April 2027

Es Devlin: Other Worlds

Enter the imaginative world of British artist and designer Es Devlin in the first retrospective in Europe celebrating her 30-year creative practice across sculpture, stage design, music, language and light.

Tickets are on sale

  • Find out more
15 October 2026 – 10 January 2027

LAIKA presents Wildwood: The Exhibition

Step behind the scenes of LAIKA's latest stop-motion film and explore how a world is built through original props, sketches, puppets, miniature sets, and more.

Tickets are on sale

  • Find out more
6 November 2026 – 8 August 2027

The Nue Black Aesthetic

Explore a major exhibition celebrating contemporary Black designers who are reshaping the design landscape, from fashion and furniture to architecture, product design and sculpture.

Tickets are on sale
